subject: MAP: security evidence runway & pen-test closure plan
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: ops@nimbushealth.com, tara.jenkins@nimbushealth.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 04 Oct 2028 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: security evidence runway & pen-test action items

Hi Tara / Nimbus ops team,

Thanks again for keeping the timeline tight — per our MAP review yesterday I'm sending the consolidated evidence checklist and the proposed closure runway. Attachment: nimbus_map_v3.xlsx (MAP owner matrix + dates).

Immediate asks:
- SOC 2: confirm the list of control owners for the infra and app tiers (fields in the spreadsheet).
- DPA: provide signed addendum or ETA if procurement needs additional redlines.
- Audit logs: export format (S3 vs managed SIEM) and earliest retention snapshot we can provide for your auditors.
- Pen test: confirm whether you want us to produce the executive summary or the full remediation log for your third-party scoping.

Proposed runway (high level):
- Week 1 (this week): owner confirmations + DPA status
- Week 2: audit log exports + SOC 2 evidence bundles uploaded to shared Drive
- Week 3: pen-test remediation notes + final MP checklist sign-off

Can each owner below reply with concrete ETAs by EOD Monday? I can help reassign if anyone is blocked.

Thanks,
Maya
Sr. Customer Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: nimbus_map_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 sheets)

From: Tara Jenkins <tara.jenkins@nimbushealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@nimbushealth.com
Date: Thu, 04 Oct 2028 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: security evidence runway & pen-test action items

Maya — thanks for the clarity and the sheet. Quick answers from Nimbus ops:
- SOC 2 owners: we will list owners in a single sheet and share by Mon EOD.
- DPA: procurement has one open clause around subprocessor disclosure; our legal will send redlines by Tue.
- Audit logs: we can provide S3 bucket access (read-only) for exports; format will be Parquet.
- Pen test: we want both the executive summary and the remediation timeline; full logs only if needed for auditor review.

We aim to stay on the proposed runway. I'm looping Ops contact here for the owner list.

Tara
Director, Infrastructure
Nimbus Health

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

> Maya — thanks for the clarity and the sheet. Quick answers from Nimbus ops:...

Thanks Tara — appreciate the S3 export plan. To make this operational I updated the MAP (see attached row summary in Drive link) and assigned owners on our side. Quick status from Redwood infra/security:
- SOC 2: infra evidence owner = Karthik Iyer (controls CC1, CC3, CC6); ETA to upload artifacts: 2028-10-12 16:00 PT.
- DPA: legal redline review owner = Neha Kapoor; action: accept/reject subprocessor clause and push to DocuSign by 2028-10-13.
- Audit logs: export access to be provisioned to Nimbus ops. Owner = Priyom (me) to confirm S3 IAM role by 2028-10-09.
- Pen test asks: we will prepare executive summary + remediation timeline. Owner = Karthik for remediation notes; ETA 2028-10-18 (we can compress if you need earlier).

Action items (short):
1) Karthik: upload SOC 2 infra artifacts to Drive (10/12)
2) Neha: finish DPA signoff + DocuSign (10/13)
3) Priyom: IAM role + S3 read-only access (10/09)
4) Maya: validate Nimbus confirms auditor access path (10/09)

If anyone needs to swap owners, call it out and I'll reassign.

- Priyom
Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Folks — quick checkpoint before EOD:

Confirmed owner updates:
- SOC 2 artifacts (infra): Karthik — uploading by 10/12 (confirmed).
- DPA: Neha — I have the redline from Nimbus legal; I'll accept the subprocessor clause with a narrow disclosure appendix and route to DocuSign by 10/13 AM.
- Audit logs: Priyom — IAM role ready, requesting final bucket name from Nimbus ops (Tara please share).
- Pen test: Karthik — will produce exec summary + remediation timeline; I will add a short remediation acceptance checklist for Nimbus auditors.

Outstanding small blockers:
- Nimbus legal asked for a brief pen-test scope statement — Tara, can you drop the scope link or a short paragraph?
- We need confirmation if auditors require raw logs or processed Parquet (Tara indicated Parquet ok).

Next steps:
- I will upload the signed DPA to DocuSign and paste the link here when complete.
- Priyom and Karthik please confirm when artifacts are uploaded so I can close the MAP ticket.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
